help.type: http downloads from a subscription URL; file reads a local file; inline writes the node list directly into the config.
help.url: The subscription link. This is a different field from the health check's own "url" below despite sharing a name — this one is a sensitive subscription credential, the probe URL is not.
help.path: For type: http, the local cache file location (optional, auto-generated if left empty); for type: file, the actual source file — required.
help.proxy: The node or policy group used to dial the subscription download itself; leave empty to download directly.
help.payload: type: inline only; writes node definitions directly into the config, in the same shape as a single entry in the proxies list.
help.health-check.url: The probe target used only for latency checks (e.g. https://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204) — not a subscription address, and not sensitive.
help.health-check.lazy: When on, only probes this provider's nodes once a policy group actually uses one, cutting down on unnecessary probe traffic.
help.filter: Only keeps nodes whose name matches this pattern; the pattern itself is configuration content executed by the Mihomo core — this tool never evaluates it.
help.exclude-filter: Excludes nodes whose name matches this pattern; the pattern itself is configuration content executed by the Mihomo core — this tool never evaluates it.
